s1.desc: a snowy town street lined with colourful shops and igloo domes

spans.view: with a soft-focus shop front with a striped awning behind her

beats.text: Polly holds {ifin} at her chest and taps at its screen with her other flipper
Polly raises a flipper to her cheek and stares wide-eyed with her beak slightly open
Polly holds the phone out to her side and sways with her eyes closed and a dreamy open-beaked smile
Polly brings the phone back to her chest and gazes down at it with teary eyes and a small smile
Polly hugs the phone to her chest with her eyes squeezed shut and a tear at each eye
Polly turns aside and presses a flipper to her face, beaming with her eyes shut and tears at their corners

spans.notes: camera locked f0-74 (ECC on the shop band 0.02-0.30: scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000). Phone back is pale grey with the lens cluster and the little tuft on top = iFin. Screen faces Polly the whole span. No overlay in the top third or bottom fifth.

f76-108: Polly turns the phone round and its screen shows a picture of Pax (seen from behind, looking into a mirror), recognisable at full res also in the wide shot f96-108. Also camera moves: a small reframing shift f75-81 (background tx 0 -> -47 px), then a fast pull-back f90-97 to a wide shot (scale 0.98 -> 0.82 -> ... ), locked again from f98. One run, one reason (lead_copy outranks camera_move).

spans.view: with a smashed black grand piano lying in the street beside her and debris scattered in front of it

beats.text: Polly holds {ifin} in front of her chest and looks at it with a worried frown while Pax lies flattened under the smashed piano with crossed-out eyes
Polly lifts the phone to her ear and waits with a worried frown while Pax lies dazed under the piano

spans.notes: starts the frame after the phone screen (Pax picture) turns away: f108 last screen frame, f109 shows the phone's back. Camera locked f98-152 (ECC on the shop band 0.28-0.45 vs f100: scale 1.0001, <1 px, cc 1.000; the sky band drifts only because the clouds move). Pax is pinned under the piano, head and belly visible, not moving. No overlay.
